name: Thai Green Curry Chicken with Snap Peas, Bell Pepper, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup jasmine rice
1 cup water
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Place broth, coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, and salt in a medium saucepan; stir to combine. Bring the curry to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
½ (398 ml) can coconut milk
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, green
1 tsp fish sauce
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the curry heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the chicken along with the snap peas.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the curry is simmering, add chicken and veggies to the pan; stir to combine. Return curry to a simmer and continue to cook until chicken is warmed through and veggies are tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the curry, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide rice and curry between plates or bowls; serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
